title: Going Places with Ernie Dingo
description: The dry and remote Lake Mungo in New South Wales west is Ernie's destination this week, where he meets up with a traditional owner, a guide and an AFLW footy player working on her farm.

title: Main Street Ontario
description: The story of the biker rally in the sleepy town of Port Dover.

title: First Contact

title: Citizen Minutes

title: Jasmine & Jambo
description: Jasmine and Jambo catch a bottle with a musical score inside that is difficult to play; both of them try playing it without much success; they create a symphony of grumbles and protests, which ends up fascinating the audience.

title: Wacky Number Songs
description: Symbols are shortcuts and are quicker than writing words; Ava shows us some cool tricks to help remember which symbol to use when comparing the value of numbers.

title: Donkey Hodie
description: Panda's pals cheer him on during "Masked Veggies.".

title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
description: Emily Elizabeth, Samantha, Pablo and Jack turn a giant cardboard box into an epic fort; they make the perfect place to play.

description: The Colorblocks travel through Colorland on an airship, picking up new and old friends along the way; the Colorblocks reminisce about all the things they've learned on their color journey.

description: Playing to an audience of toys, Bamboo Love imagines becoming a rock-and-roll guitar star; but when the only sounds expelled are from plastic buttons on a toy guitar, Bamboo Love searches for the real thing but is surprised to find various types of guitars; unsure which to use, she tries them all out and picks the one that electrifies her spirit.

title: Wolf Joe
description: When the kids help out at the local radio station, they discover a problem with the antenna is being caused by a baby raccoon.

title: Gabby's Farm
description: Gabby counts six different foods for her horse, six hungry chickens and six cows eating hay.

title: Odo
description: When Odo accidentally loses Doodle's treasure, they go on a quest to reach the end of the rainbow to find it.

title: Kid-E-Cats
description: The kittens find a platform for a giant cake meant for the Sweet Parade and with Raisin's design, they start decorating together.

title: Kangaroo Beach
description: Four junior lifeguards work under the guidance and encouragement of mature lifeguards to become heroes of Kangaroo Beach.

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: Baby coconuts with adorable big eyes are falling out of the palm trees; when one baby coconut struggles to get the hang of their legs, Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes step in to help.

description: When Riley films a Day in the Life Of... segment for the local news, a jealous Metal Mike takes over the airways with a viral video to steal all the fans in Greenville for himself. Megablast transforms into Rocket, Thunder and Metallix to take back the airwaves and teach Metal Mike that making friends and winning fans isn't something you can force on people. Then, Riley is having a bad day. All kinds of little things have gone wrong and she's feeling down.

title: Isadora Moon
description: Granny and Grandpa are babysitting Isadora and Honeyblossom; they tell their grandparents that they can drink fairy nectar, but Honeyblossom gets hyper.

Her attempts are thwarted by the fact her grandad accidentally hid it on a dark comet that moves superfast and is very hard to see, making the task very challenging. Then, Ella's excited to spend a day with her grandad collecting ingredients for a special dinner.

title: Colourblocks
description: Color Explorers and their friends Orange, Indigo and Violet, learn that colors overlap and blur in a rainbow creating in-between colors, visually showing that there are many more colors in a rainbow.

title: ABC SingSong

description: The friends are playing music together, but when it's Doodoowah's turn, he just stays silent and doesn't play at all; Doodoowah gets up and walks off, leading them all to a place where they have no choice but to be quiet.
